catalogue.university: Department of Computer Applications & Information Technology

course.title: Advanced Web Technologies
course.description: In-depth exploration of full-stack web application engineering using HTML5, CSS3, modern JavaScript, PHP 8 object-oriented paradigms, PDO transactions, and relational database systems.

module.title: HTML5 Semantics, Responsive Layouts & Bootstrap 5
module.topics: Document structure, semantic landmarks, responsive containers, CSS custom properties, accessibility guidelines.

module.title: JavaScript, DOM Manipulation & Asynchronous AJAX
module.topics: DOM traversals, client validation, event loop, Fetch API, JSON serialization, and jQuery integration.

module.title: PHP 8 Backend & Secure PDO MySQL Integration
module.topics: Session mechanics, password hashing algorithms, prepared statements, CSRF tokens, file upload verification.

module.title: XML, DTD & Web Data Exchange
module.topics: XML document tree, DTD syntax, DOMDocument parser, SimpleXML, and schema validation.

course.title: Relational Database Engineering
course.description: Advanced principles of relational database architectures, multi-table joins, subqueries, normalization theories, indexing strategies, and transaction isolation.

module.title: Relational Algebra & Schema Design
module.topics: Entity-relationship modelling, keys, constraints, functional dependencies, 1NF to BCNF.

module.title: Advanced SQL Query Optimization
module.topics: Complex joins, correlated subqueries, window functions, views, and query execution plans.

module.title: Indexing Mechanisms & Storage
module.topics: B-tree vs Hash indexing, clustered indexes, full-text indexes, and table partitioning.

module.title: ACID Transactions & Concurrency Control
module.topics: Two-phase locking, timestamp ordering, deadlocks, WAL logging, and crash recovery.

course.title: Data Structures & Algorithms
course.description: Fundamental abstract data types, memory representations, algorithmic efficiency, tree traversal algorithms, and graph networks.

module.title: Linear Data Structures
module.topics: Dynamic arrays, singly and doubly linked lists, stacks, queues, and priority queues.

module.title: Non-Linear Structures: Trees
module.topics: Binary search trees, AVL self-balancing trees, red-black trees, heap structures.

module.title: Graph Algorithms
module.topics: Adjacency lists, Breadth-First Search, Depth-First Search, Dijkstra shortest path.

module.title: Asymptotic Complexity & Sorting
module.topics: Big-O notation, merge sort, quick sort, and algorithm analysis techniques.

course.title: Computer Networks & Information Security
course.description: Network architectures, OSI layered models, TCP/IP handshakes, routing protocols, cryptography, and network vulnerability mitigation.

module.title: Physical & Data Link Layers
module.topics: Transmission media, MAC framing, CSMA/CD, Ethernet standards, error detection.

module.title: Network & Transport Layers
module.topics: IPv4 and IPv6 addressing, subnet masking, distance vector routing, TCP three-way handshake, UDP.

module.title: Application Layer Protocols
module.topics: HTTP/HTTPS, DNS resolution, SMTP, FTP, and socket communication concepts.

module.title: Information Security Essentials
module.topics: Symmetric vs asymmetric encryption, TLS certificates, firewalls, and defense in depth.
